acceptance_criteria.title: Per-space Room DB isolation
acceptance_criteria.notes: DatabaseProvider class exists in di/DatabaseModule.kt with switchTo(spaceId), close(), deleteSpaceDb(). DB path is 'spaces/<spaceId>/delphi.db'. fallbackToDestructiveMigration(dropAllTables=true) preserved. Parent directory created via mkdirs(). All DAO consumers migrated from direct injection to DatabaseProvider. No old @Module/@Provides for DB remain. SpaceSetupViewModel.init calls switchTo on active code change. No DB opened when no space is active.

acceptance_criteria.title: Space naming/renaming
acceptance_criteria.notes: SpaceManager.DEFAULT_SPACE_NAME = 'Новое пространство'. saveSpaceToList defaults to DEFAULT_SPACE_NAME. renameSpace(code, newName) trims whitespace, falls back to default if empty. SpaceSetupScreen CHOOSE mode shows space name (or formatted code if name is empty) as primary text, formatted code as secondary monospace text. Edit icon triggers inline OutlinedTextField with OK button and keyboard Done action. SpaceSetupViewModel.renameSpace wired correctly. Code field is never modified on rename.

acceptance_criteria.title: Empty trash permanently
acceptance_criteria.notes: TodoDao.deleteTrashed() query added. getTrashedIds(), deleteChecklistItemsByTodoIds(), deleteTagRefsByTodoIds() added for cascade cleanup. TrashViewModel.emptyTrash() gathers IDs, cascades deletes, then calls deleteTrashed(). TrashScreen shows trashAction button when todos.isNotEmpty(). AlertDialog with 'Очистить корзину' title, confirmation text, and 'Удалить'/'Отмена' buttons. SmartListScaffold has optional trashAction parameter with delete-forever icon.

acceptance_criteria.title: Store clears on space switch
acceptance_criteria.notes: DatabaseProvider.dbGeneration StateFlow<Int> increments on switchTo() and close(). All ViewModels (SmartListViewModel, MoreViewModel, TodoViewModel, ProjectViewModel) use dbGeneration.flatMapLatest to re-subscribe. When DB is not open, flows emit emptyList()/MoreState()/flowOf(null). SpaceSetupViewModel calls close() before clearing active code on leave. SettingsViewModel.leaveSpace() also calls close(). MainActivity guards with databaseProvider.isOpen. Sync classes access DAOs via databaseProvider at call time.

acceptance_criteria.title: spaceId derivation matches TS/Electron
acceptance_criteria.notes: Kotlin: normalizeCode (uppercase, remove dashes) -> SHA-256 -> first 16 hex chars via '%02x'.format. TS: toUpperCase(), remove dashes/spaces -> SHA-256 via crypto.subtle.digest -> first 16 hex chars. Algorithms match exactly.

acceptance_criteria.title: Build verification
acceptance_criteria.notes: Cannot run gradlew from CLI (per project constraint: build via Android Studio only). Code review confirms no syntax errors, no missing imports, no structural issues. All classes compile-compatible based on static analysis.
